ROOT CAUSE FOUND AFTERWARD: SimBankHQEnvFast.reset() always restarted at row 0 of the globally sorted dataframe (copied 1:1 from the reference PPMEnvFast), so every training episode was the exact same single-step transition (ep_len_mean stuck at 1.0 for the full 500k steps); the policy never saw more than one state during training. FIX: reset() now starts each episode at a uniformly random case's first row (see SimBankHQEnvFast.__init__ comment); the ent_coef/VecNormalize band-aids were removed (plain default PPO).
